title: Repulsive Ensembles for Bayesian Inference in Physics-informed Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2505.17308v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have proven an effective tool for solving differential equations, in particular when considering the inverse problem. When inferring solutions and parameters of the differential equation from data, uncertainty estimates are preferable to point estimates, as they give an idea about the accuracy of the solution. In this work, we consider the inverse problem for a selection of basic differential equations and employ repulsive ensembles of PINNs (RE-PINN) to obtain such estimates. The repulsion is implemented by adding a particular repulsive term to the loss function, which has the property that the ensemble predictions correspond to the true Bayesian posterior in the limit of infinite ensemble members. translated_title: 物理信息神经网络中用于贝叶斯推断的排斥集成方法
translated_abstract: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）已被证明是求解微分方程的有效工具，尤其是在考虑逆问题时。当从数据中推断微分方程的解和参数时，不确定性估计比点估计更为可取，因为它们能够反映解的准确程度。在本工作中，我们针对若干基础微分方程的逆问题，采用物理信息神经网络的排斥集成方法（RE-PINN）来获得此类估计。排斥机制通过在损失函数中加入一个特定的排斥项来实现，该项具有这样的性质：当集成成员数量趋于无穷时，集成预测将对应于真实的贝叶斯后验分布。在可行的情况下，我们将集成预测与蒙特卡洛基线方法进行了比较。标准集成往往坍缩到最大后验解，而排斥集成则能产生显著更多样的预测。
tldr: 提出在物理信息神经网络损失函数中加入排斥项的集成方法（RE-PINN），用于微分方程逆问题的贝叶斯不确定性估计，其在集成成员趋于无穷时收敛于真实贝叶斯后验，并比标准集成产生更多样的预测。
en_tdlr: Proposes RE-PINN, a repulsive ensemble of physics-informed neural networks that adds a repulsive term to the loss function for Bayesian uncertainty estimation in inverse problems, converging to the true Bayesian posterior in the infinite-member limit and yielding more diverse predictions than standard ensembles.
